reviews.title: Downloader Beware
reviews.text:
Ignoring the fact that the developers hold you captive with a long questionnaire before telling you to pay $50…

…you should ALSO know that you are giving a third party app unrestricted access to look at all of your app usage, screen time data, and even control/restrict apps, all while collecting and selling your data to who knows who. And that’s happening no matter if you pay the $50 or not!!

Make sure you take away access once you realize how encroaching this app is
